lines.en: I walk through the house carrying a vial.
There are medicine stains on my apron.

lines.zh: 我从一间房走到另一间。
lines.en: I go from one room to the next.
I step lightly so I won't knock anything over.
I pause by the window.

lines.zh: 我把架子上的瓶子摆正。
lines.en: I straighten the bottles on the shelf.
I come down the stairs.

lines.zh: 我走到门口，看了看外面。
lines.en: I go to the door and look outside.
My heels click on the floor.
My hands are never quite empty.
I round the table to shut the window.
I walk slowly to the bed.

lines.zh: 我坐着，把药瓶举到光下。
lines.en: I sit and hold a vial to the light.
I smooth the hair from my forehead.
I'm counting how many vials are left.
I dry my hands.
My cap is slightly crooked.
I'm writing up the ledger, slowly.
The light is just right here.
I hear footsteps outside.

lines.zh: 我把一只空瓶放回架上。
lines.en: I set an empty vial back on the shelf.
I'll wait a little and see.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻瓶子里的味道。
lines.en: I sniff what's in the vial.
I add a little wood to the stove.
I push the window half open.
Indoors, I still hear the wind.
There's a little red on my fingers.

lines.zh: 我把桌上的东西摆整齐。
lines.en: I set the table things in order.
I sigh, then stand again.
I tie my apron strings tighter.
Is something troubling you?
I have medicine here.
Sit down first.
You don't look well.

lines.zh: 我这间屋不大，你随便坐。
lines.en: It's a small house; sit anywhere.
What would you like to buy?
Don't track mud inside.
That wound needs washing first.
I'm busy, but I can listen.
That hand of yours is still dripping blood.
My prices are fair.

lines.zh: 你说话的时候别挥动手臂。
lines.en: Don't wave your arms while you talk.
I press gauze hard to the wound.
I clamp my teeth shut and let nothing out.
I move back to the table.
I need to stop the bleeding first.
This has left me unsteady.
The medicine spilled from my hand.
I sit down slowly on the stool.
I press a cloth to it.

lines.zh: 别担心，我知道怎么处理。
lines.en: Don't worry; I know how to treat this.
I can hold on a while longer.
You can't eat that.
I sell medicine, not meals.
Put that down.
I don't take that price.
I take red mushrooms. Have you got any?
I can't take this off your hands.
Just bring something to trade.
The vial isn't for you.
I'll note this down for now.
Are those mushrooms in your hand?
You've bumped my medicine shelf.
Careful, the vials will fall.
I steady your arm.

lines.zh: 你的鞋跟压着我的衣角。
lines.en: Your heel is pinning my hem.
We're crowded in the doorway.
I step back to let you in first.
I stumble half a step.
I hold the vials steady.
Stop crowding up against me.
I move aside and get back to work.
I'm the only one in this house.
I keep hoping someone will move in.

lines.zh: 墙上原来有张画，我留着位置。
lines.en: A picture hung there; I kept the place for it.

lines.zh: 我一个人吃饭，一个人忙。
lines.en: I eat alone and I work alone.

lines.zh: 樱花开的季节我就在这。
lines.en: I've been here since the cherry trees blossomed.
I know every path around here.
I'm glad when someone visits.
At night I keep a lamp burning alone.
I haven't much to say.
I leave the door unlocked.
This vial mustn't spill.
I put it back on the shelf.
I bend and pick up the paper from the floor.
This is still useful.
I put the red mushrooms in the basket.
What fell on the floor must be washed.
This vial is new.
I set it on the second shelf.
I counted; one vial is missing.
I lock it into the cupboard.
A patient has come.
Don't move about.
I need to look at that wound.
Sit, and roll up your sleeve.

lines.zh: 这附近的怪物最近很凶。
lines.en: The monsters around here have been vicious lately.
I heard something outside.
Get inside, quickly.
I slide the bolt home and turn the lock.
I'm waiting for you to say it plainly.
If you're hurt, don't push through it.
Don't frighten me like that.
I set down what I'm doing.

lines.zh: 门口一有影子，我就看见。
lines.en: The moment a shadow crosses the door, I see it.

lines.zh: 你走动的声音我听得清。
lines.en: I can hear you moving about.
I've left a lamp in the window.
If you're hurt, come here.
I've put the kit on the table.
You haven't sat down yet.
I'm not leaving this house.
It's getting dark outside.
Should I bolt the door?
Tell me the truth.
There's hot water in the house.

lines.zh: 这条街上的病人，我送走不少。
lines.en: I've seen many patients off on this street.
I block with a pestle.
I'm no fighter, but I'm not afraid.
Now step back.
One shove of my palm sends you back.
A vial broke. I'm sorry to see it.
I retreat behind the table.
Don't force me like this.
I put a stool in the way.
I've nothing left in my hands.

lines.zh: 我把全身的力都推出去。
lines.en: I drive my whole weight through it.
I hang the sign by the door.
This is my house.
I come out from the back room.
The cherry trees outside are in bloom.
First I light the stove.
I set the vials on the shelf.
Perhaps there'll be a visitor today.
I pat the dust off my apron.
I hear the wind outside.

lines.zh: 这个房子终于有人住了。
lines.en: This house has someone living in it at last.
I wipe the cups clean.
The door's unbarred; just push it.
My cuff caught fire; three slaps put it out.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯上摔下来，腿磕到了。
lines.en: I fall down the stairs and jar my leg.
Water closes over me and I cough badly.
The blast overturns the medicine shelf.
The arrow grazes past my sleeve.

lines.zh: 奇怪的光让我头发都竖了。
lines.en: Strange light makes my hair stand up.
I worked all day and never ate.
The thunder sets all the bottles ringing.

lines.zh: 这里没有地面，我抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: There's no floor here; nothing to hold.
